name: The Divination
summary: Thadius Grimshade turns to Sharpbeak’s feather, seeking the gryphon through its trace. He asks you to give him room as he follows the bond to its owner.

sections.title: A Ritual of Divination
sections.body: Thadius Grimshade follows the bond between Sharpbeak’s feather and the gryphon who owns it. He hopes to reach Sharpbeak himself, and asks you for silence and room to work. The ritual may not go as planned. If it does not, he warns, you had better close your eyes.

sections.title: When the Ritual Ends
sections.body: Thadius Grimshade reaches Sharpbeak through the ritual. He glimpses the gryphon and can tell you where to look.

faq.q: What is Thadius Grimshade doing in this ritual?
faq.answer: Thadius Grimshade performs a ritual to follow the link between the feather you brought and Sharpbeak. He hopes to reach the gryphon himself.
Sharpbeak is the gryphon child whose feather you brought to Thadius Grimshade. Gryphon Master Talonaxe has been trying to find him.
Thadius Grimshade warns that if the ritual goes wrong, you had better close your eyes. He asks you to give him room while he works.
